derivation: patrial from an unknown name (perhaps H5520 (סֹךְ));
def: a Sukkite, or inhabitant of some place near Egypt (i.e. hut-dwellers)

occurrences.text: With twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen: and the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt; the Lubims, the Sukkiims, and the Ethiopians.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
